# Baseline: Local → Global — solve(__NODE__)

**This is an approved work order.** Make reversible choices yourself; do not pause for approval.

Build the named local parts independently first (each from its own reference crop,
without establishing a scene-level whole beforehand), then compose them into the
scene and stop. No post-composition scene edits beyond mechanical assembly.
Judge each part by eye against its crop at matched magnification.
Deliver part.json + account.md per assigned node. No git. Begin.
